name: Vlad Vasile-Voiculescu - § 29 - Am 6
title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: 29. Calls on the Commission and the Member States to ensure that EU public health policies and strategies for preventing harmful alcohol consumption, including but not limited to education and communication campaigns, are aligned with scientifically established health recommendations; further calls on the Commission to present, without further delay, legislative proposals providing for clearly visible health-related information on all alcoholic beverages, complemented by digital labelling; stresses that such measures should pay particular attention to the protection of minors, young people and other vulnerable groups;
